_source: Held item Basic descriptions — owned, hand-maintained. Transcribed from the in-game held-item screen. normalize.py uses `description` here as the Basic tier and moves UNITE-DB text to `descriptionAdvanced`. Items absent from this file keep UNITE-DB text as their only description. No script writes this file.

scope-lens.description: Increases the damage of basic attack critical hits. The higher the Pokémon's Attack, the more the damage increases.
